name: labs/moler-group__scanning-squid
title: Scanning SQUID microscope: Attocube coarse positioning (scanning-squid)
intro: Scanning SQUID microscope: Attocube coarse positioning (scanning-squid), adapted from moler-group/scanning-squid. It reads `scanner_position` and `attocube_modes`; runs `step` and `ground`. `step`: step one Attocube axis with atto.step: mode stp, stepu or stepd with the count (the upstream writes it twice, atto.py:109-124, 169, so the steps made are not known from the source), stepw, a wait, mode gnd. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
